name: FRED API (Federal Reserve Economic Data)
notes: Nearly 820,000 economic time series from 114 sources. Free API key required (instant registration). Excellent for AI: structured time-series data, consistent schema, searchable series IDs. Covers GDP, CPI, unemployment, interest rates, housing, trade, and more. Key endpoints: fred/series/observations, fred/series/search, fred/category, fred/releases. Example: https://api.stlouisfed.org/fred/series/observations?series_id=GNPCA&api_key=KEY&file_type=json
